findings_to_judge.finding: BizLink (3665.TW), named in Credo's FY2026 10-K as the third-party manufacturer of its AEC products, printed accelerating record monthly revenue straight through Credo's fiscal Q1 (3 May - 1 Aug 2026): May NT$7.352bn (-0.4% MoM, +41.3% YoY), June NT$8.518bn (+15.9% MoM, +63.8% YoY), July NT$9.630bn (+13.1% MoM, +59.6% YoY, all-time high) — roughly +31% across the May-to-July span against a Credo revenue guide implying only +6.4% to +8.7% sequential.

Credo filed no Item 2.02 8-K — indeed no 8-K of any kind — between 1 June and 1 September 2026, even though this quarter has the same ~31-day quarter-end-to-print gap (ended 1 Aug, prints 1 Sep) as fiscal Q3 2026 (ended 31 Jan, printed 2 Mar), when on 9 February 2026 it pre-announced preliminary revenue of $404-408m against prior guidance of $335-345m nine days after quarter end.

Both mechanisms that could crash this print were pre-committed by management on the 1 June call: the CFO guided Q2 FY27 sequential growth as 'mid single digits, between our Q1 guide, and you can expect something similar in our Q2 guide' (i.e. roughly $490-500m), and guided FY27 non-GAAP gross margin 'to be broadly consistent with fiscal year 2026 levels' — whereas the -14.81% reaction on 2 March 2026 was caused specifically by cutting the Q4 non-GAAP gross-margin guide to 64-66% from 68.6% reported, not by revenue.
